name: Core filters
description: Date range with presets, select, multi-select, search, number range and toggle filters.
author: ai-bi core

filters.description: Date range with presets (today, yesterday, last7d, last30d, last90d, MTD, QTD, YTD, lastMonth, lastQuarter, lastYear, last12m, custom). Exposes start, end, endExclusive, prevStart/prevEnd/prevEndExclusive (previous equal period), lyStart/lyEnd/lyEndExclusive (same period last year), days.
Single choice from static options or a dataset. Exposes value.
Several choices (default 'all'). Exposes values (array), all (boolean), allFlag (1/0). SQL pattern: (:all = 1 OR col IN (:vals)).
Free text. Exposes text and like ('%text%').
Min/max numbers. Exposes min, max (null when open).
